raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) is a "Brain" that detects employee intent, business value, and workflow "drift." Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, with built-in approval gates. It leverages existing foundation models and focuses on understanding the "Work Graph" to identify automation opportunities.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.

raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's innovation is in its full-stack approach to AI automation within enterprises. It combines observation, intelligent analysis of work patterns, and automated agent generation and deployment, all while leveraging existing foundation models.
raw.thesis: Narma is creating an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an observation layer that captures work patterns, an intelligence layer that identifies employee intent and business value of tasks, and an execution layer that automatically generates and deploys AI agents. This system aims to provide "Continuous AI lift" by observing work, deciding what AI should do, and building agents to automate high-ROI opportunities. The venture targets AI-first enterprises struggling to measure AI savings, pinpoint ROI, and manage workflow drift. The founder's goal is to enable these companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the founder having conceptualized the layered architecture and its purpose.
